cases.title: Led project QA across HIL rigs, Gazebo simulation and Appium Android app testing
Integrated automated tests into CI/CD with stage-based reporting
Onboarded non-SQA engineers through structured QA training
Built a Python SSH-based robot monitoring tool

story.precondition: Robot health lived in scattered logs. Checking a unit meant opening an SSH session and already knowing where to look — tribal knowledge with a terminal prompt.
steps: Wrote a Python tool that opens SSH sessions to robots under test.
Pulled metrics in real time and surfaced them in one readable view.
Handed it to the wider team, so anyone — not just SQA — can read a robot’s vitals.
story.expected: Engineers see what a robot is doing while it’s doing it.
story.actual: Matches expected. Far fewer “can you check the logs?” messages. [ADD IMPACT — e.g. issues caught earlier, hours saved]
